en: Color postcard showing the Gothic St. Michael's Church with a high spire dominating a central square. In front stands an equestrian statue (Matthias Corvinus Monument) within landscaped gardens and benches, with historic façades and a red bus on the street. The back has multilingual caption naming Cluj and Liberty Square, Romanian publisher and price, handwritten Romanian message and address, and a 1975 postmark.
